description: This file defines a class and functions for adding runtime assertions for tensor shape constraints in a PyTorch FX graph, including handling symbolic shape variables and inline constraints.

classes.name: InputDim
classes.description: A NamedTuple representing an input tensor's name and its dimension index.

classes.description: A class that extends PassBase to insert runtime assertions into a FX graph based on shape constraints.

methods.description: Inserts assertion nodes into the FX graph to enforce lower and upper bounds.

methods.description: Inserts asynchronous assertion call nodes into the FX graph.
